notes.title: Civil War: Gettysburg v3.0.1 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Change: Updated some screen background images.
[*] Change: Updates button highlights.
[*] Change: Improved A.I. opponent.
[*] Change: Updated the combat capabilities of Cavalry armed only with Pistols.
[*] Change: Update the play balance in some scenarios.
[*] Fix: Issue with game hanging at the Victory and Defeat displays.
[*] Fix: Missing some mount dismount button options.
[*] Fix: Some screen layout issues.
[*] Fix: Invalid font selection on some buttons on some platforms.
[*] Fix: Some projectile animations not displaying.
[*] Fix: The in-game player message were sometimes cropped at the left edge of the screen.
[*] Fix: An issue with some load/reload animations not displaying. This could give the impression that a unit was not firing.
[/list]

notes.title: Patching in...
notes.content:
We've released a small patch to address a number of minor issues in Civil War: Gettysburg.

[list][*]Fix issue with merged unit help images not showing.
[*]Fix hotkey for showing Main Menu.
[*]Fix some missing combat analysis icons.
[*]Fix bridge behaviour.
[*]Add tooltips to Map and Main Menus.
[*]Add support for showing the current selected weapon title on Map.[/list]

We hope everyone is enjoying the game, but if anyone has any issues or suggestions please let us know at support@hexwar.com.

~ The HexWar Games Team.
